关键词: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA)
Social Impact Partnership to Pay for Results Act (SIPPRA)
New York State Energy Research and Development Authority
主要内容: On March 22, 2021, the U.S. Department of the Treasury and the U.S. Department of Labor awarded up to $8.2 million to the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA) for a project focused on providing clean energy job training to unemployed and low-wage workers. This marks the first time the Treasury Department has funded a project under the Social Impact Partnership to Pay for Results Act (SIPPRA) program. The initiative aims to increase participants’ wages and evaluate the training’s effectiveness. NYSERDA will receive up to $7.1 million if the program increases participants’ wages and an additional $1.1 million for independent project evaluation. The SIPPRA program supports pay-for-results social impact projects, including improving employment, wages, and financial stability for low-income families. NYSERDA’s project will train long-term unemployed, low-wage workers, and youth aged 16-24 for energy efficiency occupations. The funding is awarded through a competitive process, with the Treasury Department selecting NYSERDA’s project based on its potential to drive the necessary scale-up of New York’s clean energy workforce as the state transitions to a green economy.
